title: Record starting-session recommendations for every open story (#252 parts B and C)
body:
Refs #252 (parts B and C, plus the part A amendment for the canonical shape).

## What changes

**Canonical shape.** [agent-skills#58](https://github.com/jimmie-potts/agent-skills/issues/58) merged as `3746fab` (PR agent-skills#59). The parser and upsert templates now follow it:
- A required `Reviewers` row names two fresh read-only final reviewers per host, or `None` for `Investigate first`.
- `Cheaper start: none recorded; <reason>` is valid without prompts.
- Implementing prompts authorize the two reviewers ("implement it yourself without worker subagents, and use two fresh read-only Sonnet reviewers…"), so reviewers no longer break a one-shot session.
- Investigate-first prompts end with a stop line for a missing skill.

The brief shows the Reviewers row and the recorded no-cheaper reason. The README points at the policy and documents the extra strictness.

**Assessment pass (part B).** On 2026-09-25 the pass inventoried 121 open stories across the three repositories and wrote 119 sections: 111 created and 8 updated. The updates converted pre-convention sections on #252, #254, #258, #259, #262, #263, Nanoleaf #18 and Nanoleaf #110, keeping their choices. 50 stories gained a `Work assessment` section, and only for ratings they did not already record. Every write re-read the live body first, refused a story edited after it was read, and read back. A second dry run over all 119 entries wrote nothing.
- Reviewers follow the canonical reviewer policy by impact: Sonnet in Claude Code or Luna at `high` in Codex for low and medium impact; Opus or Sol at `high` for high impact.
- Availability is provisional on both hosts. Claude Code aliases were verified from this host's Agent tool on 2026-09-25. Codex was not inspected, and the agent cannot observe its own effort.
- Pending, not written: Hub #264 and Nanoleaf #139, which were in progress under other sessions. Both have since closed.
- After the write, another session edited Hub #222. I re-read it, confirmed the recommendation still fits and rewrote its section against the new text. Hub #182 was rescoped by its planning session at 05:12 UTC, after my write. The guide correctly shows it as "Needs reassessment" and it stays pending. Pixoo #77 closed after its write.
- The saved snapshot reproduces 117 of the written sections exactly. The exceptions are #182 (rescoped) and Pixoo #77 (closed).

**Guide revision (part C).**
- Snapshot refreshed at the final commit: 118 open issues.
- Coverage reconciled for 11 new stories and for 11 closures: Hub #85, #87, #181, #218 and #264; Nanoleaf #117, #131, #132, #135 and #139; Pixoo #77.
- Topic text, next steps, roadmap nodes and archive rows are updated for those closures. Roadmap arrows from the closed #85 are removed.
- One browser-check search fixture moved from the closed #218 to #253. The recommendation browser checks now run against real saved sections: #254 for a cheaper start and #20 for an insufficient story.

## Assessment report

- Policy `agent-skills@3746fab`.
- The installed catalog under `~/.agents/skills` is still at `3e009e6`. I read the merged revision from Git and did not update the installation.

**Counts at the final snapshot (118 open):** 82 recommended, 35 insufficient, 1 pending (rescoped by its planning session after the write).
